note: Inputs of the Advancement layer: raw values of the advanced sub-indicators per council, collected from data-source/ with their method. The layer is computed beside the Core and never changes it.
rangeNote: Reference ranges and weights are those of src/data/inform-advanced-spec.json: ranges are relative (set from the span of the council values at first computation, as the workbook does for its own indicators); weights are proposed, not calibrated (ADV-04). Each value is standardised once; there is no second rescaling (MET-09).
exposureNote: These sub-indicators measure hazard intensity on each territory, not the people exposed as INFORM's own hazard indicators do (MET-16).

HA.NAT.DR-ARID.source: CHIRPS v3 monthly precipitation and ERA5 2 m temperature (Thornthwaite PET)
HA.NAT.DR-ARID.method: Annual P / PET on the council polygon, 1991-2020 climatology (scripts/compute-aridity.py)

HA.NAT.DR-NDVI.source: MODIS MOD13Q1 NDVI (250 m), Google Earth Engine
HA.NAT.DR-NDVI.method: Zonal mean greenness on the council polygon, 2001-2020 (scripts/compute-gee-eo.py)

HA.NAT.DR-SOIL.source: NASA-USDA SMAP 10 km surface soil moisture, Google Earth Engine

HA.NAT.FL-R50.method: Days with council-mean rainfall above 50 mm, per year, 2015-2024 (scripts/compute-council-climate.py)

HA.NAT.FL-R100.method: Days with council-mean rainfall above 100 mm, per year, 2015-2024 (scripts/compute-council-climate.py)

HA.NAT.LS-SUSC.source: SRTM 30 m elevation, Google Earth Engine
HA.NAT.LS-SUSC.method: Mean terrain slope on the council polygon, degrees (scripts/compute-gee-eo2.py)

HA.NAT.LS-RAIN.source: CHIRPS daily rainfall, Google Earth Engine

HA.NAT.ST-WIND.source: ERA5-Land daily 10 m wind, Google Earth Engine
HA.NAT.ST-WIND.method: Period maximum of daily maximum wind speed, 2015-2023 (scripts/compute-gee-eo2.py)

HA.NAT.HW-DAYS.source: ERA5-Land daily maximum 2 m temperature, Google Earth Engine
HA.NAT.HW-DAYS.method: Days per year with Tmax above 35 C, 2015-2023 (scripts/compute-gee-eo2.py)

HA.NAT.DR-SPEI.source: CHIRPS v3 monthly rainfall and ERA5 2 m temperature
HA.NAT.DR-SPEI.method: Mean magnitude of SPEI-12 during drought months on the council polygon, 1991-2024 (scripts/compute-council-drought-members.py)

HA.NAT.DR-CV.method: Interannual coefficient of variation of annual rainfall on the council polygon, 1991-2024 (scripts/compute-council-drought-members.py)

HA.NAT.EQ-HIST.method: Events within 50 km of the council centroid, 1960-2024, scaled to events per 100 years (x 100/65; scripts/compute-council-earthquake.py)

HA.NAT.EQ-FELT.method: Maximum felt intensity at the council centroid over the events of 1960-2024: max of 1.5 M - 1.5 log10(R + 15), a simple attenuation (scripts/compute-council-earthquake.py)

VU.VG.DP-UNHCR.source: UNHCR Tanzania operational data 2024 (rounded camp and urban figures)
VU.VG.DP-UNHCR.method: Refugees and asylum-seekers hosted in the district (Nyarugusu, Nduta, transit and urban caseloads), copied to its councils (data-source/displaced_refugees.csv)

HA.NAT.FL-EVENT.source: Recorded flood events compiled from PMO-DMD, DesInventar, EM-DAT and press reports
HA.NAT.FL-EVENT.method: Number of recorded flood events in the district, 2010-2024 (data-source/flood_events.csv), copied to its councils; the committees' validated event reports replace this file

CC.INF.HC-DENS.source: 2022 Population and Housing Census geodatabase (NBS/OCGS), facilities spatially joined to the 195 council polygons with the facility types filtered
CC.INF.HC-DENS.method: Health facilities (dispensaries, health centres, hospitals) per 10,000 people of the council (2022 census; scripts/spatial-join-facilities-councils.py)

CC.INF.EDU-DENS.source: 2022 Population and Housing Census geodatabase (NBS/OCGS), facilities spatially joined to the 195 council polygons with the facility types filtered
CC.INF.EDU-DENS.method: Schools (pre-primary to secondary) per 10,000 people of the council (2022 census; scripts/spatial-join-facilities-councils.py)

CC.INS.DRR-STAT.source: PMO-DMD list of DRM arrangements (June 2026) and the DRR records approved through the Data portal
CC.INS.DRR-STAT.method: Count of the arrangements recorded for the council (EPRP, anticipatory action, EOCC, ERT, RVCA), 0 to 5, computed by the engine from the council's record (src/engine/risk/advanced.ts)

HA.NAT.DR-SEAS.reason: Growing-season failure frequency is withheld: the method scores the single wettest 4-month window, which mis-scores bimodal councils (issue MET-01). Both rainy seasons must be scored (data-source/seasonality_zones.csv) before use.

flood_s1.note: Sentinel-1 wet-season water fraction minus permanent water (data-source/flood_s1_councils.csv) has no basket entry and is flagged as a research artefact; not used.
